messages.subject: Hey guys, does anyone know how to process the ion mobility MSI data in the Cardinal?
parts:
Dear All:

Thank you very much for your help. Currently, we have acquired some ion mobility MSI data via Waters MS instrument, but we found most commercial software and scripts for MSI cannot process the multi-dimensional ion-mobility MSI data. So does anyone know how to load the drift time together with the MSI data?

Thank you
